config.schedule: schedules=['interleaved']; interleaved uses ae_prob=0.5, combined uses CE + 2.0*recon on every batch
config.loss_recon: MSE between reconstruction and input (NAN: mean over batch x neurons x pixels; ANN: mean over batch x pixels)
config.learning_rule: AUXILIARY-LOSS: cross-entropy is backpropagated through the head into the hidden layer, so the encoder is shaped by BOTH objectives. This is the Weeks 5-10 arrangement and is NOT the rule described in Bull (2025).
config.init: PyTorch defaults for Linear; NAN/ANN decoders kaiming_uniform (models.py)
config.eval: full test set after every epoch
